Wɔleebi lala aaate shi kɛba oŋɔɔ,
Bo ni oyɔɔ daa kɛyaashi naanɔ.
Odebɔɔ yɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ miijie oyi,

hymns.t: Nyɔŋmɔ Hejɔlɛ lɛ Tamɔ Faa ni Hoɔ
v: Nyɔŋmɔ hejɔlɛ lɛ tamɔ faa ni hoɔ,
Eyeɔ kunim daa nɛɛ kɛtekeɔ nɔ,
Yɛ emuuyeli mli ehoɔ yɛ daagbi,
Emli kwɔɔ ni edaa, tsɛ eye emuu.
Ekɛ amɛ eto yɛ ekɔkɔ mli,
Nyɛlɔ, sɛɛtsɔɔlɔ ko nyɛŋ afite nii;
Haomɔ kɛ naagba hɔŋ nyɛŋ abɛŋkɛ jɛŋ,
Gbeyeeshemɔ mumɔ ko hu bɛ jɛmɛ.
Miishɛɛ kɛ jɔɔmɔi fɛɛ jɛɔ ŋwɛiɔTsɛ lɛ dɛŋ,
Mɛi ni heɔ Lɛ yeɔ naa enɔkwayeli.
Hulu shinyɔɔ mli ji naakpɛɛ nɔ ko,
Shi naakpɛɛ mli naakpɛɛ ni hãa mi miishɛɛ
Shi naakpɛɛ mli naakpɛɛ ni hãa mi miishɛɛ
c: Oo naakpɛɛ nɔ ni fe fɛɛ,
Oo naakpɛɛ nɔ ni fe fɛɛ,

v: Ni omli nui lɛ amli lɛ
Oo La ni kpɛɔ migbɛ nɔ daa
Maŋɔ mila ni gboɔ mahã o
Oo miishɛɛ ni taoɔ mi yɛ piŋmɔŋ,
Hã magb’le mitsui mli mahã o,
Naa, migbo yɛ shikpɔŋ mlu mli,
Shi otee mi shi kɛjɛ jɛŋ
Nɛkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ s’mɔ wɔ, etsu H’relɔ,
Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔ wɔ, es’mɔ mi hu.
Etsu H’relɔ lɛ, Jielɔ ni ajɔɔ,
Eŋɔ mi ekoŋŋ, oo Nyɔŋmɔ gbeŋ.
Anumnyam kɛ woo, oo naanɔ Suɔmɔ,
Aŋɔ ahã o wala be fɛɛ hu.
Jwɛŋmɔ kpleee he, ni aheee hu,
Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ kp’le ni mli kwɔ,
Wɔnaa Bo faŋŋ yɛ mɔ ni ba
Bat’re sɛŋ’tso hã wɔ lɛ mli;
Mɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ tsu kɛjɛ ŋwɛi,
Ni h’reɔ kɛjɛɔ gb’le duŋ mli;
Yɛ je nɛɛŋ oshrai fɛɛ kwa mli;

hymns.t: Oo Nyɔŋmɔ Jeŋ ni Yɔɔ Naakpɛɛ
v: Oo Nyɔŋmɔ jeŋ ni yɔɔ naakpɛɛ,
Shi ehooo Tsɛ lɛ kwɛmɔ he!
Jeee gbɔi ji wɔ yɛ je nɛɛ mli
Kɛ jakui ni yɔɔ he fɛɛ he.
Oo jeŋ be yɛ afii amli,
Gbi ko lɛ be damɔ shi diŋŋ,
Be ni sɛŋmɔtso ko te shi
Yɛ yiwalɛ gɔŋ grɔŋŋ ko nɔ.
Nɔnaa kɛ gb’le mli suɔmɔ tsɔ,
Ni be naakpɛɛnii lɛ je kpo.

hymns.t: Kɛ Mikɛ ŋwɛi Bɔfoi Alilɛi Wieɔ
v: Kɛ mikɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi alilɛi wieɔ,
Kɛ mihiɛ teemɔŋ nilee naa samfee
Ni mibɛ suɔmɔ lɛ, fɛɛ fɛi,
Suɔmɔ ŋmɛɔ etsui shi, eleee mɔ nyɛɛ,
Tsɛ teemɔŋ nilee fɛɛ baaho aya,
Hiɔ shi, shi suɔmɔ fe fɛɛ.
Kɛ mibɛ suɔmɔ lɛ, fɛɛ fɛi,
Le akɛ lɛ pɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ,
Kɛ wɔdu gbɛ tamɔ toi lɛ,
Ni je lɛ kɛ wiemɔi huuhai
Oo ja anumnyam Maŋtsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi,
Mɔ ni hiɔ kpɛmɔ mli, esa yijiemɔ.
Eha jeŋ fɛɛ, ni etade ji la.
Emlifu gbeŋ lɛ ji nugbɔ shiimɔi lɛ,
Ni duŋ ji egbɛ hu yɛ ahui anɔ.
Ekwɛmɔ ni fa, mɛɛ lilɛi aaagba?
Eyɛ kɔɔyɔɔ mli, ekpɛɔ yɛ la mli;
Ehoɔ kɛjɛɔ gɔjiaŋ kɛtsɔɔ jɔi amli,
Ni enyɔɔ tamɔ bɔ loo nugbɔ nɛɔ lɛ.
Sumlibii hu po ni wɔhe hu waaa,
Ha wɔ hejɔlɛ, oo Nuntsɔ jurɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ ni omli jɔ, jelɛŋbii ekwa
Omlai krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ owiemɔ lɛ;
Kaahã omlifu miite shi yɛ wɔ nɔ,
Hã wɔ hejɔlɛ, oo Nuntsɔ jurɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ, jalɛ Lumɔ! wɔwo Bo muji,
Shi naanɔ owiemɔ hiɔ shi kɛyaa;
Amale kɛ efɔŋ kɛ Bo ehiii shi;
Hã jalɛ ashw’re, oo Nuntsɔ jurɔ.
Ni wɔɔja o kɛ shidaa kɛ heshibaa tsuii,
Ojie wɔ kɛje osh’ra kɛ gb’le mli;
Wɔɔla waa kɛjɛ ŋshɔŋ kɛya ŋshɔŋ:
Mɔ ni fãa ŋshɔ kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ,
Oo bo wɔ toi, kɛ wɔtsɛ Bo
Kɛhã mɛi ni nyiɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ.
Kristo, mɔ ni nui nu ogbeŋ
Bo mɔ ni onyiɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ
Oo bo wɔ toi, kɛ wɔtsɛ Bo
Kɛhã mɛi ni nyiɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ.
Nui lɛ ahiɛ yɛ duŋ lɛ mli,
Oo bo wɔ toi kɛ wɔtsɛ Bo
Kɛhã mɛi ni nyiɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ.
Shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋshɔŋ fɛɛ ahã o.

Kɛji minyiɛ koi kɛ tsei ashishi lɛ
Kɛji mikwɛ kɛjɛ gɔŋ yiteŋ shɔŋŋ lɛ,
Minuɔ fai kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ blɛoo ahe.
Ni kɛ mijwɛŋ akɛ okãmaaa obi
Ni bagbo lɛ, mijwɛŋmɔ hu shɛɛɛ he;
Akɛ et’re mijatsu yɛ sɛŋ’tso nɔ,
Ekɛ ela gbe mihe eshai lɛ.
Be ni Kristo aaaba kɛ oshebɔɔ lɛ,
Eeebaŋɔ mi, mɛɛ miishɛɛ kp’le ji no.
Mikɛ shidaa yijiemɔ kp’le aaaja lɛ,
c: No hewɔ lɛ, milaa mihãa o, Nyɔŋmɔ,
No hewɔ lɛ, milaa mihãa o, Nyɔŋmɔ,

v: Mɔ ni hã wala kɛ dalɛ,
Mɔ ni toɔ je lɛŋ gbɛjianɔ,
Fe fɛɛ, kɛtsɔ Bi lɛ nɔ;
Mɔ ni toɔ je lɛŋ gbɛjianɔ;
Mɔ ni kɛ wɔtoiboo tsuɔ nii,
Ni hã ŋshɔ lɛɛ ha jeŋ fɛɛ,
Tsei kɛ fɔfɔii ni yɔɔ jeŋ fɛɛ
He ko bɛ ni wɔaatee hu
Efee ŋwɛi kanei ni kpɛɔ lɛ,
Ohiɛ lɛ, biɛ loo jɛi ko bɛ,
Gbɔ loo maŋsɛɛ ko bɛ kɛhã o,
Yɛ maji lɛ kɛ he fɛɛ he,
Oo fɛo Nyɔŋmɔ ni anaa lɛ
Yɛ wiemɔ ni tsɔɔ lala mli;
Mɔ ni wala jie ohiɛ kpo,
Oo nii ni kwɔ fe Kerubim,
Bo mɔ ni shiɛɔ naanɔ Wiemɔ,
La, bo mɔ ni adro fe fɛɛ,
Kɛhã Tsɛ, Bi, kɛ Mumɔ lɛ,
Leebi la lɛ, kɛ fɔfɔi lɛ
He fɛɛ he, ekɛ mi wieɔ.
Nuntsɔ yeɔ Maŋtsɛ yɛ jeŋ fɛɛ!
Nyɛnyaa, Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ.

hymns.t: Nii Fɛɛ ni Kpɛɔ ni Yɔɔ Fɛo
c: Nii fɛɛ ni kpɛɔ ni yɔɔ fɛo,
Nii ni hi ni yɔɔ naakpɛɛ,

v: Tsɔɔ akɛ Nuntsɔ lɛ sa woo.
Shi yɛ dromɔ ni h’re wɔ lɛŋ
Kɛtsɔ lá ni j’ra wa lɛ nɔ.
Nii ni fe fɛɛ ni aŋma lɛ,
Wɔɔwie Toobi lɛ gbɛi he daa
Ni wɔɔja yɛ Etsɛ lɛ hiɛ.
Baa kɛ tso fɛɛ ni kulɛ
Jeŋ fɛɛ eyi kɛ fɛo sɔŋŋ,
Lɛ, ŋaalɔ ni fe fɛɛ lɛ
Ni yɛ fɔmɔ hee lɛ mli

hymns.t: Atatui Ni Yɔɔ ŋwɛi Shɔŋŋ Lɛ
v: Atatui ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ,
Kɛ ŋwɛi bluu ni eyɔɔ fɛo lɛ,
ŋwɛi ni asaa kɛ lai ni kpɛɔ
Ni hulu ni etɔɔɔ lɛ lɛ
Ekɛtsɔɔ yɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ nɔ
Agbɛnɛ be ni je naa lɛ,
Nyɔŋts’re hu tsaa sane lɛ nɔ;
Daa, kɛhã jeŋ ni boɔ toi lɛ;
Kɛ anuuu gbeŋ loo wiemɔ ko,
Ni nyam gbeŋ amɛkɛ kɛɔ po,
“Mɔ ni bɔ wɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ni.”

hymns.t: Nyɔŋmɔ Mɔ ni Fee Jeŋ Hei fɛɛ
v: Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni fee jeŋ hei fɛɛ
Be fɛɛ yɛ jeŋ saji amli
Loi ni yɔɔ nui lɛ amli?
Gbɛi ni sa yɛ je nɛɛ mli.
Kɛ osh’ra hu yi ogbɛ nɔ,
Nii ni aaahia lɛ, eeehã fɛɛ,
Nɔ ko bɛ ni ooobi n’eekwa,
Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni kaa lɛ yɔɔ hãa,
Kpasamɔ lɛ, mɔ ni etɔ o,
c: Gbi fɛɛ gbi nɔ, be fɛɛ mli;

v: Duŋ ko bɛ ni aaahã ni okpale,
Bɔ ni oji, nakai k’aatee naanɔ.
Latsaabe kɛ fɛibe, dumɔ kɛ kpamɔ,
Hulu, nyɔŋts’re, ŋulamii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi,
Eshaifaa, toiŋjɔlɛ, ni hiɔ shi be fɛɛ,
Bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiɛ ni woɔ hewalɛ,
Hewalɛ hã ŋmɛnɛ, hiɛ’kãmɔ hã wɔ,
Tsɛ ehãa nii loo eŋɔɔ nii,
Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni bɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Mɔ ni buɔ ohe lɛ, ewɔɔɔ wɔd-i;
Naa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ wɔɔɔ gbi ko gbi ko,
Shwane mli lɛ hulu ko eshaŋ bo,
Nyɔŋ hu, nyɔŋtsere efeŋ bo nɔ ko.
Eeebu ohe kɛje efɔŋ fɛɛ mli,
Lɛ mɔ ni wɔŋɔɔ woo fɛɛ wɔhãa lɛ,
Aaabu ohe, be nɛ kɛ naanɔ fɛɛ.
Ni kɛ minyiɛ kɛdu gbɛ lɛ
Tsɔɔ mi gbɛ ni ja hu.
Kɛ minyiɛ gb’le hɔŋ jɔɔ lɛŋ lɛ,
Be ni mɛi yaa kɛ baa;
Ni kɛtsɔ Obi lɛ nɔ lɛ
Be ni lumɔi fɛɛ sɛɛ efo.
Etsɔɔ wɔ gbɛ yɛ jeŋ fɔŋ nɛɛŋ
Be ni jeŋ fɔŋ nɛɛ eho kwraa.
Mɛɛ jɔɔmɔ nɛ, akɛ dromɔ ba,
Dromɔ ni kɛ mi shɛ biɛ nɛɛ,
Be ni wɔhi jɛi afii pii,
Dromɔ ni da fe wɔeshai fɛɛ,
Jɛŋ ashwie Toobi lɛ la shi yɛ.
Dromɔ ni da ni anyɛɛɛ agba
Dromɔ ni yɔɔ kɛyaa naanɔ fɛɛ,
Naakpɛɛ yaka dromɔ ni nɔ bɛ;
Aŋɔɔ akeɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni he ye,
Bo mɔ ni ootao ehiɛ ona;
c: Dromɔ ni fɔɔ eshai fɛɛ kɛyaa,
Dromɔ ni da fe wɔeshai fɛɛ.

v: La mli la, tsoo hã wɔ
Tsɛ ejie enyam kpo yɛ biɛ,
c: ŋulamii ba ŋwɛi kɛtsɔ naakpɛɛ gbɛ nɔ
Je lɛ tsotsro shi yɛ ŋwɛi yɛ naakpɛɛ gbɛ nɔ,
Etsɔ naakpɛɛ suɔmɔ kɛ dromɔ nɔ!

v: Kpɛ la wo jeŋ hee lɛ mli,
Tsɛ, Bi kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ fɛɛ,
Nyam fɛɛ aŋɔ ahã Bo daa,
Ni naanɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ tsui lɛ
Kɛ wɔɔs’mɔ Lɛ kɛ wɔtsuii fɛɛ,
Ni yeɔ awrɛhoo yɛ je nɛŋŋ;
Oo ba, Bo Nilee ni jɛ ŋwɛi,
Baabua onii ni gbɛshwa lɛ naa.
Otsɔɔ wɔ onilee gbɛ lɛ hu,
Naataamɔi, nyɛɛ kɛ tai sɛɛ afo,
Ni jeŋ ayi kɛ ŋwɛi hejɔlɛ.

hymns.t: Lɛ Eji Tsɛ Lɛ Suɔmɔ Bi
v: Lɛ eji Tsɛ lɛ suɔmɔ Bi
Kɛhã nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ lɛ
Oo nyɛ ŋwɛinii fɛɛ nyɛwoa lɛ,
Kɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ Tsɛ kɛ Bi lɛ,
Kɛ Tsɛ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ fɛɛ,
Klɛŋklɛŋ bronya lɛ, bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ
Nyɔŋ be ni fɛi miiye naakpa.
Ni ekɛ la kple hã je lɛ,
Ema nɔ nyɔŋ kɛ shwane fɛɛ.
Bɔ ni ŋulami lɛ tsɔɔ lɛ.
Edamɔ jɛŋ be muu lɛ fɛɛ
Yɛ he gbɛ ni Yesu kã lɛ.
Nyɛ tookwɛlɔi ni yɔɔ ŋa nɔ
No he la miikpɛ yɛ jɛŋ.
La lɛ h’reɔ yɛ hei fɛɛ
Ni baa yɛ duŋ lɛ mli
Be ni ŋwɛi ta kple lɛ
c: Gɔji kɛ jɔi kɛ he fɛɛ he,

v: La kɛ wala ehãa mɛi fɛɛ,
Mɔ ni ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ jaa,

Too wɔ yɛ ogbɛ lɛ nɔ,

Yɛ kooloiatsu ko mli ni saatso ko bɛ,
Wɔ-Yesu fioo lɛ ekãshi yɛ jɛŋ
ŋulamii miikwɛ lɛ he ni ekã lɛ,
Wɔ-Yesu fioo lɛ wɔ yɛ jwɛi lɛ nɔ.
Kooloi lɛ miibɔlɔ, gbekɛ lɛ hiɛ tsέ,
Shi Yesu fioo lɛ, lɛ efee dioo.
Miisumɔ o Nuntsɔ, kwɛmɔ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi;
Ni kɛ mi ahi shi jenamɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ.
Hii mimasɛi, Yesu, ni ohi shi kwraa,
Kpɛtɛmɔ mihe daa, ni osumɔ mi,
Jɔɔmɔ gbekɛbii bibii fɛɛ ni okwɛɔ,
Ni hã wɔba ŋwɛi wɔkɛ o ahi shi.
Tsui fɛɛ tsui asaa gbɛ ’hã lɛ,
ŋwɛi kɛ, ŋwɛi kɛ nii fɛɛ ala.
Jeŋ fɛɛ anya, Lɛ ji lumɔ,
ŋmɔji kɛ fai, tɛi, gɔji kɛ jɔi
Yɛ hei ni, yɛ hei ni loomɔ yɔɔ.
Kɛ naakpɛɛ, kɛ naakpɛɛ suɔmɔ lɛ.

hymns.t: Kpɛ Waa, Oo Bo ŋwɛi La Fɛɛfɛo
v: Kpɛ waa, oo bo ŋwɛi la fɛɛfɛo,
Kpɛ waa, oo bo ŋwɛi la fɛɛfɛo,

Nyɛ bɔfoi ni jɛ shɔŋŋ ba,

hymns.t: Nyɔŋteŋ Be Ni Jeŋ Etse Pam
v: Nyɔŋteŋ be ni jeŋ etse pam,
Ni bɔfoi ba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ
Ni je lɛ mli fee kpoo kɛ dioo
Nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛjatsu tsii,
Ni tɔlɛ sɔŋŋ yɔɔ nyɛgbɛ nɔ,
Oo nyɛnaa tsui yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ
Oo nyɛbaa, heyelɔi, kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ nyamɔ,
Nyɛbaa, Oo nyɛbaa Betlehem maŋ lɛ mli,
ŋwɛi bɔfoi lalɔi, nyɛlaa kɛ mliflimɔ,
Oo nyɛ ni ji ŋwɛimaŋbii fɛɛ nyɛlaa
Anumnyam hã Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi floflo.
Nuntsɔ wɔŋfla Bo n’afɔ leebi j’rɔ nɛɛ,
Tsɛ lɛ Wiemɔ lɛ epue yɛ heloo mli.
Ewɔ fuaa yɛ jwɛi saatso lɛ nɔ;
Be ni nilelɔi lɛ gba ebaa lɛ;
Hã tsuii ah’re kɛ suɔmɔ krɔŋŋ,
Wɔnii fɛɛ lɛ bo onɔ ni,
Kwɛ bɔ ni naakpɛɛ keenii lɛ,
Toi ko nuŋ ebaa lɛ he,
Humii fɛɛ ni aaaŋɔ Lɛ lɛ,
Gɔŋ kɛ jɔi, fai anɔ wɔtsɔ
Mire ni naa wa ji minɔ,
Eŋma lɛ tsɔɔ sɔ ni joɔ;
c: Oo naakpɛɛ ŋ’lami yɛ duŋ mli,

v: ŋ’lami ko yɛ boka gbɛ maŋkɛ nɛɛ,
Ekɛ o aaaya H’relɔ lɛ fɔmɔhe,
Kɛ obo bɔfo lɛ wiemɔ lɛ toi,
Ni ohiɛ aaakpa otoo ku lɛ nɔ,

hymns.t: Be ni Tookwɛlɔi Buɔ Toi Ahe
v: Nyɛ kɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ kwa baana
Obatao mi yɛ je nɛɛ mli;
Gbɛ yɛ mitsui mli kɛhã Bo.
Yɛ kooŋ tsei ahɔŋ lɛ mli,
Mɛɛ gbekɛ nɛ, ni ewɔ kpoo
Be mli ni bɔfoi laa lalai,
He ni kooloi yeɔ nii yɛ?

hymns.t: Nyɔŋ Kpoo lɛ, Nyɔŋ Krɔŋŋ lɛ
v: Nyɔŋ kpoo lɛ, nyɔŋ krɔŋŋ lɛ,
Nyɔŋ kpoo lɛ, nyɔŋ krɔŋŋ lɛ,
Nyɔŋ kpoo lɛ, nyɔŋ krɔŋŋ lɛ,
Nyɔŋ kpoo lɛ, nyɔŋ krɔŋŋ lɛ,
La ni kpɛ yɛ Betlehem lɛ
Oo la fɔfɔi ni jeɔ ŋma
Lɛ Mɔ ni tsots’ro tso nɔ lɛ
Ni Mɔ ni gbo yɛ Kalv’ri lɛ
Kristo, Mɔ ni ŋwɛi fɛɛ woɔ lɛ
Ni no hã nu lɛ tsɔ wain;

hymns.t: Mijwɛŋɔ, kɛ Mikane Blema Sane Lɛ
v: Mijwɛŋɔ, kɛ mikane blema sane lɛ,
Be ni Yesu yɔɔ wɔteŋ lɛ,
Bɔ ni etsɛ gbekɛbii kɛba eŋɔɔ,
Ni kulɛ mikwɛ ehiɛ be ni ekɛɛ,
Miishwe nakai anumnyam miishɛɛ be lɛ,
Nakai ŋɔɔmɔ be fe fɛɛ lɛ,
Be ni gbekɛbii fɛɛ ni jɛ he fɛɛ he
Edamɔ shi kɛ nyam ni kpɛɔ;
Mla lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ
Nyɔŋmɔ wie yɛ shiimɔ lɛ mli,
Mla kɛ gbalɔi kwaa yɛ ehiɛ;

hymns.t: Oo Suɔmɔ Ni Da, Ni Mli Kwɔ
v: Oo suɔmɔ ni da, ni mli kwɔ,

Tamɔ nui yiɔ ŋshɔ mli lɛ.
Ni jeŋ fɛɛ aaayi kɛ Nyɔŋmɔanumnyam lɛ
Tamɔ nui yiɔ ŋshɔ mli lɛ.
Ja Nyɔŋmɔ hã wu lɛ w’la.
Shi fioo, fioo lɛ be lɛ mibɛŋkɛ
Ni jeŋ fɛɛ aaayi kɛ Nyɔŋmɔanumnyam lɛ
Tamɔ nui yiɔ ŋshɔ mli lɛ.
Oo, ajɔɔ shikpɔŋ kɛ maŋ fɛɛ,
He ni Kristo yeɔ lumɔ yɛ;
Miishɛɛ baa tsuii kɛ shĩai amli,
He ni kunim Maŋtsɛ lɛ yɔɔ.
He ni awula kɛ ŋwɛi nii,
Fɛɛ ni hulu teɔ shi yɛ;
Laa esuɔmɔ kɛ gbeŋ ni ŋɔɔ;
Mɛi ni haoɔ naa hejɔlɛ daa,
Bɔɔnii fɛɛ ate shi kɛ woo
Ni jeŋ ah’re nɔ kɛ amen.
Lalai hee aaagbɛɛ yɛ jeŋ fɛɛ.
Kristo etsɔ gbɛ hee ko nɔ
Oo Nuntsɔ, tsɔɔmɔ wɔ gbɛ lɛ
Hã wɔ omiishɛɛ yɛ je nɛɛŋ,
Be ni wɔkɛ o aaaye lumɔ
Oo Kristo, Nuntsɔ ni te shi,
Mɛi ni ekɛ dromɔ h’re nyɛ,
Hã jeŋ jakui kɛ lilɛii fɛɛ
Ni gbɔmɛi kɛ nii fɛɛ kwa
Mɛi ni boɔ toi lɛlɛɛŋ lɛ
Ni ji mɔ ni wo shi lɛ
Ni gbo hã wɔ lɛ toi.
Mɔ ni baa ehe shi lɛ
Nii fɛɛ kwa ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi
Ye kunim yɛ duŋ lɛ nɔ;
No lɛ leebi be woɔ duŋ,
Kpɛɔ kɛtsɔɔ mi gbɛ ni ja,
Wɔŋtsɛ Bo yɛ owe nɛɛ mli,
Ni jɛɔ odɛŋ lɛ mli daa;
Eyeɔ nɔ yɛ bee fɛɛ mli;
Sane krɔŋŋ lɛ mli la lɛ fɛɛ
Kɛ wala mli haomɔi kp’le mi,
La ni jɛɔ sɛŋ’tso lɛ nɔ lɛ
Miishɛɛ yɛ be fɛɛ be mli.

hymns.t: Kwɛ Bɔ Ni Yesu Gbɛi ŋɔɔ Hã
v: Kwɛ bɔ ni Yesu gbɛi ŋɔɔ hã,
Mana hã mɔ ni h-mɔ yeɔ;
Shi kɛ mina o bɔ ni oyɔɔ,
Bo omli miishɛɛ krɔŋŋ jɛɔ baa,
Oo, Bo, Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ gbɔmɔ Bi
Mɔ ni hãa tsui ni ehao laa.
Fe bɔfoi ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ fɛɛ.
Bo, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi kɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi!
Mɛɛ gbee loo tsui aaanyɛ ala
Loo aaanu gbɛi ni ŋɔɔ f’ogbɛi,
Shi mɛi ni naa Bo lɛ aaanya,
Nɔ ni Yesu suɔmɔ lɛ ji,
Hejɔlɛ ni jeŋ hãa lɛ shɛɛɛ,
Mɛi ni tsɛɔ o lɛ ohereɔ,
Mɛi ni taoɔ o naa omlihilɛ,
Mɛi ni naa o lɛ naa nii fɛɛ kwa.
Ni ola ayi jeŋ muu fɛɛ.
Otsi muu lɛ mli gbii fɛɛ,
Yɛ mitsui mli, shi jeee ŋwɛi,
Naanɔ tete po fã aa hã okafomɔ.
Ni ŋɔ ehe kɛ kp- mi,
Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni ji kέ,
Mɔ ni gbo ham’ suɔmɔ lɛ pii.
Eyɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ, male pii,
Enɔ ji nyam jwetri lɛ fɛɛ;
Male pii yɛ ebaa lɛ he.
c: Mɔ ni gbo ham’ suɔmɔ lɛ pii.

hymns.t: Woo Sa, Woo Sa Toobi Lɛ
v: Woo sa, woo sa Toobi lɛ,
Woo sa, woo sa Toobi lɛ;
Woo sa, woo sa Toobi ni
No hewɔ daa be fɛɛ be,
Tsui ni mli fliɔ yɛ suɔmɔŋ.
Gbɛi ni ŋɔɔ fe gbɛii fɛɛ.
Mɔ ni gbo kɛ h’re mi;
Etsɔɔ mi ela ni j’ra wa
Etsɔɔ mɔ ni kɛ suɔmɔ kple
Nyɛjiea eyi! Yesu, wɔɔH’relɔ ni ajɔɔ!
La, oo jeŋ, gbaa enaakpɛɛ suɔmɔ lɛ!
Nyɛwoa lɛ, nyɛ bɔfoi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ,
Nyam kɛ woo ahã egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ!
Taakɛ kwɛlɔ, Yesu buɔ ebii ahe,
Nyɛjiea eyi! Yesu, wɔɔH’relɔ ni ajɔɔ!
Wɔ’eshai hã ena nɔ ni egbo;
Lɛ ji wɔɔTɛsaa, hiɛnɔkamɔ kɛ h’remɔ;
Nyɛjiea eyi! Yesu ni asɛŋ lɛ,
Nyɛjiea eyi! Yesu ni t’re wɔhaomɔi,
Naakpɛɛ suɔmɔ ni mli kwɔ, ni mli wa.
Nyɛjiea eyi! Yesu, wɔɔH’relɔ ni ajɔɔ!
ŋwɛi agboi miigbɛɛ waa kɛ hosiana,
Yesu, H’relɔ, ye lumɔ kɛya naanɔ fɛɛ;
Yesu miiba, eye je lɛ nɔ kunim,
Hewalɛ kɛ nyam ahã Nuntsɔ lɛ.
c: Nyɛjiea eyi kɛ miishɛɛ lalai daa.

v: Kɛgbɛ kɛshwa jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ,
Yesu, gbɛi ni fãa gbeyee fɛɛ
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni aaakɛɛ po,
Yɛ jeŋ muu lɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ
c: Eyɛ, eyɛ, Yesu Kristo yɛ daa,
Ekɛ mi nyiɛɔ, ekɛ mi wieɔ

v: Mɔ ni na nɔ yɛ tso lɛ nɔ,
Maŋtsɛ Bi ni ta sɛi lɛ nɔ;
“T oobi ni agbe lɛ sa woo!”

hymns.t: Gbɛi ko Bɛ ni Tamɔ Yesu
v: Gbɛi ko bɛ ni tamɔ Yesu,
Ej’ra wa fe gbɛi fɛɛ gbɛi;
Gbɛi ko mɛ ni tamɔ Yesu
Gbɛi ko bɛ ni tamɔ Yesu
Yɛ eŋmɔ mli daa kɛ daa;
c: Gbɛi ko bɛ ni tamɔ Yesu;
Gbɛi ko bɛ ni tamɔ Yesu.

v: Oo bo Yesu nɛɛ gbee toi.
Gbɛi ko bɛ ni fe Yesu.
Yesu gbɛi ni j’ra wa lɛ.
c: Gbɛi ni ŋɔɔ yɛ ŋwɛi lalaŋ,
Gbɛi ni ŋɔɔ hã gbɔmɛi hu.

v: Minyɛŋ makɛɛ nɔ hewɔ mɔ ni bɔfoi
Jaa Lɛ lɛ sumɔɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ nɛkɛ.
Kɛba Lɛ eŋɔɔ yɛ naakpɛɛ gbɛ nɔ.
Shi mile akɛ Maria fɔ lɛ yɛ
Bet’hem, ni kooloi atsu fee eshĩa.
Ehi shi yɛ Nazaret ni etsu nii;
Hewɔ lɛ je lɛ mli fɛɛ H’relɔ lɛ eba.
Minyɛŋ makɛɛ bɔ ni enɔnaa kpoo lɛ
Loo etsui kumɔ yɛ sɛŋmɔtso lɛ nɔ;
Shi mile akɛ etsaa tsui ni ekumɔ,
Ni egbeɔ wɔeshai kɛ gbeyee hu,
Ni ewoɔ jatsu yɛ gbedelɔi anɔ,
Ejaakɛ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ h’relɔ lɛ yɛ biɛ.
Minyɛŋ makɛɛ bɔ ni eeeh’re maji lɛ,
Ni eeeŋɔ jeŋ ni laaje lɛ ekoŋŋ;
Shi mile akɛ wɔɔna enumnyam lɛ.
Ni Lɛ, ebaakpa ŋmaa ni edu lɛ;
Ni no gbi lɛ ehulu aaakpɛ kãŋkãŋ,
Be mli ni aaale jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ h’relɔ lɛ.
Minyɛŋ makɛɛ bɔ ni mɛi fɛɛ baaja Lɛ,
Ni ahum aaaŋmɛ dioo yɛ ’famɔ naa;
Loo namɔ aaanyɛ agba nyamɔ kple hu
Be ni wɔtsui aaayi kɛ esuɔmɔ.
Shi mile akɛ ŋwɛi fɛɛ aaajie eyi,
Gbei akpei nyɔŋma toi akpe aaala,
Ni naagbee lɛ, shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋwɛi aaah’re nɔ
Akɛ, jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ h’relɔ lɛ ji Maŋtsɛ.
Nyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsuji, nyɛshiɛa Nuntsɔ lɛ,
Nyɛwoa Yesu gbɛi ni yeɔ kunim lɛ nɔ,
Nyam ji emaŋtsɛyeli yɛ nii fɛɛ nɔ.
Wɔ-Maŋtsɛ yɛ ŋwɛi, h’relɔ wulu ni,
Shi ebɛŋkɛ wɔ, eyɛ wɔteŋ hu;
Mɛi fɛɛ ala waa kɛhã Bi lɛ woo,
ŋwɛi bɔfoi laa kɛjieɔ Yesu gbɛi lɛ yi,
Ni amɛbuɔ shi amɛjaa Toobi lɛ.
B’lɛ wɔ hu wɔja lɛ, nakai sa Lɛ,
Nyam kɛ hewalɛ, nilee kɛ nyɛmɔ
Woo kɛ jɔɔmɔi fɛɛ, kɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi fɛɛ tswɛm,
Ni emli akpɛ kɛ ola krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Kɛyaashi fɛɛ aatsɔ mulu kɛ lamlu;
No awula mi, ni ekpɛ migbɛ nɔ.
Ni fe bɔ ni adesai aaanyɛ atã;
Yɛ he ni Mumɔ ’Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɔ shi yɛ.
Bɔ ni nyɛmimɛi kpe ye nii
Wo mi ob- kɛ ola krɔŋŋ,
Ba, oo ba, wo mi ob-.
Ba, oo ba, wo mi ob-.
c: Wo mi ob- kɛ ola krɔŋŋ,

v: Ni yɛ la lɛ puemɔ mli lɛ
Gbalɔi lɛ ho; bee kplaŋŋ sɛɛ lɛ
Ni yɛ hulu shinyɔɔ sɛɛ lɛ,
Lɛ, ni ji la mli La,
Oo, hã wɔ wala wiemɔ lɛ,
Hã wɔ kpoo kɛ heshibaa tsui

hymns.t: ŋɔɔmɔ, ŋɔɔmɔ Mumɔ ko Yɛ Biɛ
v: ŋɔɔmɔ, ŋɔɔmɔ Mumɔ ko yɛ biɛ,
Ni mile akɛ Nuntsɔ mumɔ lɛ ni;
Miishɛɛ kɛ ŋmlɔ yɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ,
Mile akɛ amɛŋnu Nuntsɔ lɛ he.
Hã manyiɛ gbɛ ni sa nɔ.

hymns.t: Oo Wala La Lilɛi Ni Tso
v: Oo wala la lilɛi ni tso
Ni hã amɛtao ŋwɛi sɛɛ gbɛ
Be ni Elia nu he lɛ?
Be ni nyam kpɛ yɛ Mose hiɛ,
Loo Hiob ye kaa nɔ kunim lɛ?
Be ni wɔŋɔɔ wɔtsuii wɔhãa o,
Ni mi kɛ bo aaahi shi yɛ
Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ ba, baaŋɔ mitsui nɛɛ;
ŋɔɔ mi kɛje jeŋ hejramɔi fɛɛ mli,
Ni ohã masumɔ Bo bɔ ni sa.
Loo su nɛɛ gbɔjɔmɔi nɛɛ shɛtemɔ,
Loo bɔfoi asramɔ, loo ŋwɛi gblemɔ;
Shi akɛ ojie mitsui mli duŋ lɛ.
Oo, hã matao Bo, koni mana o.
Hã male akɛ obɛŋkɛ mi daa,
Hã mafi shi yɛ mihaomɔi amli,
Hã mas’mɔ Bo tamɔ obɔfoi lɛ,
ŋwɛi okpo ni ba lɛ abaptist mi;
Ni okp’la wɔ kɛnyiɛ w’la gbɛi
Shii buu yɛ mitsui nɛɛ mli,
Hã wɔ oŋwɛi suɔmɔ krɔŋŋ lɛ,
Oo, hã jeŋ nii aje wɔhiɛ,
Bo ji suɔmɔ ni bɛ naagbee lɛ,
Oo Nyɔŋmɔ kɔɔyɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni tswaa,
Bo ji dumɔwu ni Nyɔŋmɔ duɔ,
Bo ji wɔwala lɛ shishi fã;
Oo Nyɔŋmɔ Nugbɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni nɛɔ,
Bo ji mligbɛ gbee lɛ ni tsɛɔ mi;
Bo ji Kristo hewalɛ ni baa;
Kuu w’la aboloo lɛ, hã mi Nuntsɔ,
Tamɔ okumɔ yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ naa;
Oŋmalɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ matao Bo yɛ,
Bo ji w’la aboloo hã mi, Nuntsɔ,
Hã maye ni mana naanɔ wala,
Mumɔ kɛ wala ji owiemɔi lɛ,
Bo pɛ ji miwalɔ kɛ miwala,
Hã mi ŋmalɛ lɛ, mimiishɛɛ ŋulami
Ni hãa shikpalɔ miishɛɛ y’ahum mli;
Ahum ko nyɛŋ agbe nɛkɛ toiŋjɔlɛ,
Hã mi ŋmalɛ, be ni mitsui ekumɔ,
Hã mi Yesu naawiemɔi ni j’rawa lɛ
Hã mi ŋmalɛ lɛ, efee migbɛ nɔ la,
Ni male oshra yɛ jeŋnii ahe;
Ola lɛ aaajie duŋ lɛ yɛ migbɛ nɔ,
No pɛ aaanyɛ atsɔɔ hejɔlɛ gbɛ.
c: Hã mi ŋmalɛ lɛ, wiemɔ la krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ,
Ola aaakpla mi yɛ gbɛ leleoo nɔ,
Kita, shiwoo, mla kɛ suɔmɔ aaatsu nii
Kɛyashi duŋ aaalaaje yɛ la hiɛ.

v: Ni oshiwoi lɛ nɔŋŋ hãa mi
He ni w’la nui hoɔ yɛ;
Ni la nɛɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ ewoɔ
Lɛ nɔ yɛ jeŋ muu fɛɛ.
Ni kɛ duŋ sɛɛ aaafo lɛ
Oo la Nyɔŋmɔ, owiemɔ lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ;
Eeeje gbɛ yɛ wɔduŋ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ mli;
Wɔtse atua moŋ, shi otao wɔ kέ;
Owie kɛtsɔ bɔfoi kɛ gbalɔi anɔ,
Be babaoo eho, shi owiemɔi lɛ gbooo,
Ni mɛi ni biɔ, ni shweɔ otsamɔ lɛ
Naa omlijɔlɛ yɛ H’relɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Otsɛmɔ lɛ miiya gbɔmɛi fɛɛ aŋɔɔ
Yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ jeŋ he fɛɛ he;
Ni lilɛi srɔtoi aaala lala kple lɛ
Woo hã Wiemɔ ni tsɔ gbɔmɔ

hymns.t: Wɔŋda O Shi Hã ŋmalɛ Krɔŋŋ lɛ
v: Wɔŋda o shi hã ŋmalɛ Krɔŋŋ lɛ,
Ni ŋma, bu he, ni tsɔɔ shishi;
Hã obii yɛ he fɛɛ he.
Wɔŋda o shi hã ŋmalɛ Krɔŋŋ lɛ,
Kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni tsuɔ onii,
Hã obii yɛ he fɛɛ he.
Wɔŋda o shi hã ŋmalɛ Krɔŋŋ lɛ,
Hã obii yɛ he fɛɛ he.
Wɔŋda o shi hã ŋmalɛ Krɔŋŋ lɛ,
Wɔtsuii, ni yɛ Yesu mli lɛ
Hã obii yɛ he fɛɛ he.
Yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ;
Oo wa wɔ ni wɔbo Bo toi,
Hã wɔhi shi yɛ nakai naa,
Yɛ tsui, wiemɔ kɛ feemɔ mli.

hymns.t: Ba, Bo Mɔ ni Ji Esha Nyɔŋ
v: Ba, bo mɔ ni ji esha nyɔŋ,
Yesu shwie ela krɔŋŋ lɛ shi
B’lɛ, baafata ku krɔŋŋ nɛɛ he
Ni oyahi shi yɛ ŋwɛi maŋ,
Nyɛbaa, mɛi ni kumai yeɔ nyɛ,
Nɔ kɛkɛ ni Lɛ etaoɔ ji
c: Mate shi, ni maya Yesu ŋɔɔ,

v: Oo Kpɔl-, ba mli, ba mli,
Miyɛ H’relɔ ko, eefã mihe yɛ ŋwɛi,
Shieŋtsɛ H’relɔ ni, tsɛ jeŋ nanemɛi faaa,
Kέlɛ ekɛ hedɔɔ suɔmɔ miibu mihe;
Hã H’relɔ nɛɛ afee bo hu oɔH’relɔ!
Miyɛ Tsɛ ni ehã mi hiɛnɔkamɔ
Etsɛŋ ni eetsɛ mi kɛya eŋɔɔ yɛ ŋwɛi,
Oo, ni eeehã mi kɛ bo fɛɛ aaatee jɛŋ.
Miimɛ yɛ ŋwɛi, ni mikɛ naakpɛɛ aaakwɛ;
Oo, be ni mana atade kɛɔkplɛmɔ nɛɛ,
Naanyo j’rɔ, ani bo hu ooona eko?
Kɛ Yesu kpɔ bo lɛ, gbaa mɛi sane lɛ,
Akɛ miɔH’relɔ lɛ hu ji oɔH’relɔ;
Sɔlemɔ ni amɛ hu amɛba nyam mli,
Aaabo sɔlemɔ lɛ toi – abotoi ’hã bo.
c: Bo misɔleɔ mihãa, bo misɔleɔ mihãa,

v: Eŋɔɔmɔ gbeŋ kɛɔ wɔ daa daa,
Ni wɔs’mɔ bo fe nii fɛɛ.
Kristo ni ajɔɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ hãa,
Gbaa sane kpakpa ni ŋɔɔ nɛɛ,
Ni feɔ wɔ krɔŋk rɔŋ kwraa.
Blɛoo kɛ suɔmɔ Yesu kɛmiitsɛ bo,
Eesra hã mi kɛ bo fɛɛ.
Mɛɛba otsɛɔ be ni Yesu miikpa fai,
Miikpa fai hã mi kɛ bo;
Jwɛŋmɔ enaakpɛɛ suɔmɔ shiwoo lɛ he,
c: Blɛoo kɛ hiɛdɔɔ. Yesu kɛmiitsɛ o

v: Kɛ minyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ
Suɔmɔ yeɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ nɔ;
Suɔmɔ yeɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ nɔ,
H’relɔ lɛ miimɛ ni eba otsui mli,
Nɔ ko bɛ jeŋ ni baagb’la okɛ Lɛ teŋ,
Naanyo, kɛ ooofa onane kɛba lɛ,
ŋɔɔ lɛ, ni oduŋ lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ aaafo kwraa;
c: Be kɛ be nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ emɛ aahu,
Eekwɛ akɛ ooogbele shinaa lɛ lo,

v: Oo susuma, etɔ o kɛ haomɔ?
Onaaa la ko yɛ duŋ lɛŋ lo?
H’relɔ lɛ oookwɛ ni ooona la
Ebaafee nɔ ni ewo shi lɛ,
Hewɔ lɛ yaa, jeŋ ni hiɛŋkpãtã,
c: Ni jeŋ nibii fɛɛ aaafee sulii ko
Yɛ edromɔ kɛ nyam la lɛ mli.

v: Wɔleko Bo bɔ ni sa kwraa,
Oo, Nuntsɔ, hã wɔ nilee tsuii,
Hã wɔhiɛ atέ, ni wɔle o.
Wɔsheko o gbeyee bɔ ni sa,
Hã wɔ tsui krɔŋŋ kɛsumɔ Bo,
Oo, hã wɔ hiɛdɔɔ kɛ nyɛmɔ
Mɛɛbe wɔɔle Bo bɔ ni sa,
Wɔɔye emuu yɛ ŋwɛi maŋ lɛŋ?
Jɛ hela mli ba hewalɛ mli,
Jɛ hiamɔ mli ba ninamɔ mli,
Miba omiishɛɛ we ni kpɛɔ lɛŋ,
Ni mana ohiɛ nyam daa kɛ daa,
Bo wɔ toi ni otsa wɔ.
H’lu ni teɔ shi yɛ wɔ nɔ;
Hewalɛ lɛ yɛ elá lɛ mli;
Hewalɛ lɛ yɛ elá lɛ mli,
Baatsuu ohe yɛ Kalvari lá lɛŋ,
Hewalɛ lɛ yɛ elá lɛ mli;
c: Yɛ Toobi lá ni j’rawa lɛŋ.

v: Ji akɛ, Yesu gbo hã mi,
Tsuu mihe ni mayɛ fe snoo,
Oo Drolɔ, hã mi tsui hee,
Yɛ ola ni j’ra wa lɛŋ,
Shi Bo pɛ ooohã dromɔ lɛ
Ni hiɔ saji amli kpɛŋŋ daa
Nyɔji pii ni mɛihiɔ wɔ lɛ
Hã ni nu kɛ ola lɛ
Ja oh’re, ni ja Bo pɛ.
Mabɛŋkɛ o, mafee otsui he nɔ,
Gb’lamɔ mi, oo Nuntsɔ, ni oj’ra wa,
Mihiɛɛɛ nɔ ko hã Yesu, mi-Maŋtsɛ –
Hã mi hetsuumɔ yɛ olá lɛ mli,
Hã mi hetsuumɔ yɛ olá lɛ mli.
Ekɔnɔi kɛ ewoo lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm,
Hã mi Yesu, mi-Nuntsɔ ni asέŋ,
Ha mi Yesu, mi-Nuntsɔ ni asɛŋ.
Nakai eeeji yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ mli;
Gbi fɛɛ gbi, be fɛɛ be,
Shĩa ko yɛ ŋa kplanaa lɛ nɔ,
Yɛ shwane hulu la ni tsoɔ
Lɛ, mɔ tuuŋtu ni gbo lɛ su,
Mɔ ni na nɔ hã mi;
Mitaooo hulu la ko dɔŋŋ fe
Mimii shɛɛɛ jeŋ nii ahe dɔŋŋ,
Hãa wɔtsuii tswaa kɛ miishɛɛ kέ,
Ni wɔɔshiɛ o hu kɛ suɔmɔ,
Wiemɔ kɛ jeŋba ni sa fɛɛ;

c: ŋɔɔ je nɛɛ mli nii fɛɛ,

v: Onɔ ji mi, Nuntsɔ, minu ogbee,
Oo Nuntsɔ ŋɔɔ mi ofee otsulɔ
ŋmlɛtswaa kome kɛkɛ yɛ osɛi hiɛ
Ni kɛ miku’a ohiɛ yɛ sɔlemɔŋ,
Biɛ miŋɔɔ nii fɛɛ mihãa o –
Mɛni ji jeŋnii, ŋɔɔmɔ kɛ gbɛi
Makwa fɛɛ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ,
Be ni mikwaa jeŋ akɔnɔi lɛ,
Yɛ ohiɛ lɛ, mina nii fɛɛ kwa,
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mikɛ hã lɛ,
Mɛɛ aaatsi mi kɛ lɛ teŋ?
Jeŋ nɔ ko nyɛŋ agb’la mi dɔŋŋ,
Yɛ je nɛɛŋ kɛtee nyam mli fɛɛ,
Yɛ ŋwɛi ekɛ mi aaakpe yɛ,
c: Yɛ shĩa mli, mɛi ateŋ fɛɛ,

v: Hã ni daa gbi lɛ manyiɛ
Yɛ faa ni hoɔ lɛ sɛɛ.
Olá oŋɔ shwie shi hã mi,
Bo ni olá fɔɔ muji fɛɛ,
Hέɛ, fɛɛ lɛ oŋɔɔ anaa yɛ;
Bɔ ni miyɔɔ, no nɔŋŋ oooŋɔ,
Ola oŋɔ shwie shi hã mi,
Bo ni ola fɔɔ muji fɛɛ;
Hέɛ, fɛɛ lɛ oŋɔɔ anaa yɛ;
Bɔ ni miyɔɔ, no nɔŋŋ oooŋɔ,
La ni aaakpɛ yɛ migbɛ nɔ
Nɔ ni mis’mɔɔ ni mijaa lɛ,
Hã je lɛ fɛɛ afee diŋŋ,
He ni ŋwɛi bɔfoi bu ohe
Tsɔɔmɔ mi nakai bu f’lo lɛ,
Daa gbi lɛ, Nuntsɔ, hã mat’re
Nuntsɔ Yesu, mihe atse kɛmɔ shi,
Miiba o, baahi mitsui mli kɛya naanɔ;
Jw’ramɔ wɔŋ fɛɛ wɔŋ, shwiemɔ henyɛlɔi fɛɛ,
Agbɛnɛ juu mihe, ni mayɛ fe snoo.
Nuntsɔ Yesu, kwɛ kɛjɛ oŋwɛi sɛi nɔ,
Ye obua mi, mafee afɔle ni sa;
Mi kɛ nɔ ni mile fɛɛ miŋɔ hã Bo,
Agbɛnɛ juu mihe ni mayɛ fe snoo.
Nuntsɔ Yesu, nɔ kome kɛkɛ mibiɔ;
Onaji ni asɛŋ anaa mimɛɔ yɛ
Agbɛnɛ juu mihe ni mayɛ fe snoo.
Nuntsɔ Yesu, tsuishitoo mikɛ mɛɔ Bo,
Mɛi ni taoɔ osɛɛ lɛ, oshwieko daŋ,
Agbɛnɛ juu mihe ni mayɛ fe snoo.
c: Mayɛ fe snoo, hɛɛ, mayɛ fe snoo,
Agbɛnɛ juu mihe, ni mayɛ fe snoo.

v: Naakpɛɛ ji onitsumɔi kɛ ogbɛi lɛ!
Kέlɛ ohiɔ shi yɛ humii atsui mli.
Hegbɛi fɛɛ Nuntsɔ, mitsui miŋɔ hã o,
Mikɛ suɔmɔ toiboo aaatsu onii lɛ.
Nilee fɛɛ Nuntsɔ, miyiŋ miŋɔ hã o,
Anɔkwale ni nilee shɛɛɛ he mana,
Nii ni hiŋmɛi enako, toi nuko daŋ,
Ji nii ni Mumɔ lɛ tsɔɔ yɛ Wiemɔ lɛŋ.
Ni fɛɛ a-Nuntsɔ, mihe miŋɔ hã o;
Kɛji mikwa Bo ni migbee shi po lɛ,
Shi mibo owiemɔ toi yɛ s-ɔmɔ mli,
Mashɛ gbɛ lɛ naagbee yɛ heyeli mli.
Mi Yesu mis’mɔɔ Bo ni minɔ ji Bo,
Kɛ mas’mɔ Bo kwraa lɛ, Yesu, ŋmɛnɛ ni.
Bo tsutsu os’mɔ mi hewɔ mis’mɔɔ Bo,
Owo minyɔmɔ lɛ yɛ Kalv’ri tso nɔ;
Ni ofi ŋmei akek’re yɛ mihewɔ;
Kɛ mas’mɔ Bo kwraa lɛ, Yesu ŋmɛnɛ ni.
Yɛ wala mli k’aatee gbeleŋ, mas’mɔ Bo,
Gbi abɔ ni mimuɔ lɛ, majie oyi;
Kɛ gb’le bɔ aaashwie minɔ tete, makɛɛ:
Kɛ mas’mɔ Bo kwraa lɛ, Yesu, ŋmɛnɛ ni.
Makafo Bo yɛ ŋwɛi maŋ ni kpɛɔ lɛ mli;
Mala be ni mibu shikafai ni kp’lɛɔ;
Kɛ mas’mɔ Bo kwraa lɛ, Yesu, ŋmɛnɛ ni.
Naatsii ko bɛ mi kɛ H’relɔ lɛ teŋ,
Je nɛɛ mli lakamɔnii ko bɛ;
Mikwa jeŋ esha akɔnɔi lɛ fɛɛ,
Yesu ji minɔ, naatsii ko bɛ.
Naatsii ko bɛ, jeŋ akɔnɔ ko bɛ:
Wala mli nifeemɔi ni sa po
Lɛ ji minii fɛɛ! naatsii ko bɛ.
Naatsii ko bɛ, nɔnai pii tete po,
Tsɛ jeŋ fɛɛ aaate shi awo mi;
Maye kunim, ni naatsii ko bɛ!
c: Naatsii ko bɛ mi kɛ H’relɔ lɛ teŋ,
Koni mana enyam hiɛ muu lɛ;
Nɔ ko etsiii enikenii lɛ naa kwraa;

hymns.t: Oo Ham’ Tsui Kɛjie Nyɔŋmɔ Yi!
v: Oo ham’ tsui kɛjie Nyɔŋmɔ yi!
Tsui ni daa lɛ enaa ola
Ni shwie shi hã mi lɛ.
Tsui ni he jɔ kɛ heshibaa,
He ni Kristo gbee pɛ anuɔ
ŋmaa ogbɛi hee lɛ yɛ mitsuiŋ,
Mishiii nɔ ko, migb’laaa shi hu,
Mas’mɔ mahi la lɛ mli daa,
Matsu jalɛ he nii daa nɛɛ,
Shi mɛɛ ninamɔ kple ji no,
Hã jeŋ muu fɛɛ akwa mi po,
Nii fɛɛ mli lɛ ooona miishɛɛ
Kέ yɛ nɔ ko feemɔ mli.
Kwɛ Mumɔ ni yɔɔ omli lɛ;
Kwɛ nɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ ehã o;
Jɛɛ dromɔ mli kɛya nyam mli,
Ni kɛ gbee lɛ bote mitoiŋ lɛ,
Hã maŋɔ Yesu moŋ fe shikai abɔ,
Matsɔ enɔ moŋ fe ninamɔ kpɔtɔɔ,
Hã maŋɔ Yesu, fe shĩai kɛ shikpɔji,
Enine ni ap’la lɛ akp’la mi.
Maŋɔ Yesu moŋ fe jeŋ fɛɛ yijiemɔ,
Maye egbɛi lɛ he moŋ anɔkwa.
Ehe yɛ fɛo fe jeŋ fɔfɔi fɛɛ fɔfɔi;
Eŋɔɔ fe wo ni jɛ agbaku mli po;
Lɛ kɛkɛ mimumɔ shweɔ daa be fɛɛ be,
Maŋɔ Yesu, ni lɛ eeetsɔɔ mi gbɛ.
c: Fe nɔ ni matsɔ maŋtsɛ kple yɛ jeŋ,
Hã maŋɔ Yesu moŋ fe nɔ fɛɛ nɔ

v: Dabi, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ sɛŋ’tso,

hymns.t: ŋɔɔ Je Lɛ, Shi Hã Mi Yesu
v: ŋɔɔ je lɛ, shi hã mi Yesu;
Jeŋ ŋɔɔmɔi fɛɛ lɛ, gbɛi f’lo,
Shi Yesu suɔmɔ hiɔ shi daa,
ŋɔɔ je lɛ, shi hã mi Yesu,
Ni kɛ lɛ ekwɛɔ minɔ lɛ,
ŋɔɔ je lɛ, shi hã mi Yesu;
ŋɔɔ je lɛ, shi hã mi Yesu;
Be ni nii fɛɛ aaafee faŋŋ lɛ,
Mana lɛ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ kέ.
c: Oo, mɛɛ suɔmɔ kple ji no!

v: Loo ni maje gbɛ lɛ nɔ
Oo, mina faa ni tsuɔ fɔɔ lɛ,
Mina bɔɔnɔ hee lɛ te shi,
Ewieɔ ni su fɔŋ lɛ gboɔ
ŋwɛi la lɛ naa minyiɛ yɛ nɛɛ
Kɛ tsui krɔŋŋ kɛ atade yɛŋ,

hymns.t: Yɛ Yordan Naa Baptis’lɔ Lɛ Bo
v: Tee shi, bo lɛ toi shi ehiɛ
B’lɛ tsuii fɛɛ aje esha he;
Wo ohiɛ nɔ yɛ wɔnɔ koo,
Tsɔɔmɔ mi ni mawo Bo daa
Ni yɛ Bo osuɔmɔ naa lɛ,
Yesu tao mi, tsɛ mileee lɛ,
Kɛ ela ni j’ra wa lɛ.
Yɛ dromɔ hiɛ be fɛɛ be;
ŋɔɔ mitsui lɛ ni osɔo naa
Ni tsa mi kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ lɛ;
Faa ko yɛ ni eyi kɛ lá
Ni t-lɔi ni muɔ mle yɛ mli
Julɔ lɛ na nubu lɛ ni
Bo Toobi ni gboɔ, olá lɛ
Kɛjɛ be ni mina faa nɛɛ
No mli mala kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ pii
Be ni aaatee lilɛi nɛɛ shi
Akpɔ mi kɛ Toobi lɛ lá;
Mile akɛ maŋtsɛ fai ko yɛ
Kɛmiimɛ mi yɛ ŋwɛi shĩa lɛ.
Ni etsɛŋ ni mi kɛ hetselɔi
Kɛ Nuntsɔ lɛ fɛɛ aaahi shi.
c: Akpɔ mi kɛ Toobi lɛ lá;

v: Akpɔ mi kɛ Toobi lɛ lá;
Mana Maŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ enyam mli,
Mɔ ni kɛ suɔmɔ kple kudɔɔ mi,
Ni ehãa milaa yɛ duŋ mli.
Yɛ duŋ kɛ kaa mli fɛɛ lɛ
Kɛ ta gba wo mi tete,
Gbaa miishɛɛ nɛɛ yɛ hei fɛɛ,
Anumnyam hã Mawu, nii wuji efee;
Esumɔ je lɛ, eŋɔ ebi ehã,
Mɔ ni kɛ ewala kpãtã wɔesha,
Ni egb’le wala shinaa kɛhã mɛi fɛɛ.
Oo kpɔmɔ, oye emuu, lá akɛ he,
Nyɔŋmɔ shiwoo kɛhã mɛi fɛɛ ni heɔ yeɔ;
Eshafeelɔiatsɛ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ hu,
Nakai be lɛ, aaana faa yɛ Yesu dέŋ.
Nii wuji etsɔɔ wɔ, nii wuji efee,
Ni wɔnyaa pii yɛ Yesu, Ebi lɛ mli;
Shi nii ni yɔɔ krɔŋŋ ni da fe enɛ ji,
Wɔɔshɛ ŋwɛi ni wɔna Yesu hiɛ kɛ hiɛ.
c: Oo, ba Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ kɛtsɔ

v: Be ni wɔkai ni wɔya hiɛ,
Te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni je bemligb’lamɔi
Ni leee bɔ ni je bɔleɔ h’lu
Kɛ gbɛi ni adesa ewo lɛ,
Aaakɛɛ nɔ ko hee ebɔi lɛ?
Shi kɛtsɔ Yesu w’la kɛ gb’le nɔ,
B’lɛ wɔkɛ ekãa yɛ Mumɔ lɛŋ
Ashi nii ni eho yɛ sɛɛ,
Kɛtao nii hee, ni wɔɔna kέ.
Yesu hiɛ kã, ni etsɔ wɔhiɛ

c: La, oo, la yɛ Kpɔlɔ lɛ he,

v: Ni da fe fɛɛ ahã Zion,
Bo wɔsɔ’lmɔ toi, akɛ ŋmɛnɛ kɛ daa
Gbalɔi kɛ shiɛlɔi agbee fɛɛ afee faŋŋ
H’remɔ wiemɔ kɛtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ,
Jɔɔmɔ hã loomɔ, hejɔlɛ hã ta.
Nilee, tsuishitoo ahã mɛi ni tsɔɔ nii
Yɛ jamɔ kɛ shiɛmɔ kɛ s-ɔmɔ fɛɛ mli
Nuntsɔ, hã wɔ nikeenii bɔ ni sa pɛ,
Ahã Tsɛ lɛ, Bi lɛ, kɛ Mumɔ lɛ.
Jeee tsui ni akɛ niji fee
Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ hiɔ shi yɛŋ;
Ewe lɛ yɛ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ floflo,
Shi, Lɛ, mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ
Tsɔ suɔmɔ nɔ kɛwɔ hi shi,
Wɔ, tɛi ni hiɛkã ji etsu,
He ni mɛi taoɔ ehiɛ yɛ lɛ
Shi yɛ nɛkɛ je nɛɛ we nɛɛ
Yɛ bee fɛɛ amli, oo Nuntsɔ,
Nyɛ, ny’aana mihiɛ, jeee je lɛ;
Tsɛ mɛi kɛ naakpɛɛ kwɛɔ lɛ
Bo, adebɔɔ fɛɛ mli La krɔŋŋ,
Ni bee pii lɛ wofoɔ wɔhe
Be mli ni duŋ kpii miiwo,
Tamɔ bɔ ni mis’mɔ nyɛ lɛ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mabi mi-Tsɛ
Nuntsɔ, ye obua osafo lɛ koni
Omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ama shi yɛ biɛ,
Kudɔmɔ ni wɔna suɔmɔ yɛ wɔteŋ,
Jiemɔ wɔhewoo, wɔnii wɔja kɛ mɛi.
Nuntsɔ, feemɔ wɔ ekome yɛ omli
Ni suɔmɔ afee klɛŋklɛŋ yɛ ni fɛɛ mli;
Hã wɔ dromɔ kɛbotoi, ni wɔwie faŋŋ;
Hã wɔ shidaa tsuii kɛhã okeenii lɛ.
Tsu, kpo, kpata, nitsumɔhe kɛ hei fɛɛ,
Ni wɔhiɔ ohiɛ yɛ lɛ yɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ hu,
Wɔbe ni wɔkɛ tsuɔ nii lɛ hu yɛ krɔŋŋ,
Hã wɔyiŋtoo kɛ hewalɛ afee krɔŋŋ.
Hã wɔkɛ mɛi fɛɛ ahi shi jogbaŋŋ daa.
Kristo, hiɛkãalɔ lɛ kɛwɔ ahi shi,
Hã wɔjamɔ afee krɔŋŋ, wɔw’la aŋɔɔ.
Yɛ Kristo mli wɔnaa wala nyam muu lɛ;
Duŋ wo wɔ, hiɛnɔkamɔ fee yaka,
Wɔna mɔbɔnalɛ ni mɛɔ wɔ lɛ.
Kɛ musuŋtsɔlɛ akwɛ obii ni pleɔ
Wɔnaa ekpakpa fɛɛ yɛ Kristo mli.
Wajemɔ osafo lɛ yɛ jeŋ f-ŋ nɛɛŋ,
Ni eshiɛ e-Nuntsɔ lɛ sane lɛ
Kaashi be ni jeŋ ni wuɔ ta nɛɛ aaanya
Ni eeenu suɔmɔ lala wulu lɛ.

hymns.t: He ni Wala Gbɛi Pii Kpeɔ yɛ
v: He ni wala gbɛi pii kpeɔ yɛ,
Ni anuɔ jaku kɛ kuu gbee,
Nu kɛ kp’lu ni aŋɔ hã o lɛ
Kɛjɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, oo Nuntsɔ,
Tsa nɛkɛ tsuii ni naa nɔ nɛɛ;

hymns.t: Mɛi ni S’mɔɔ Bo kɛ Omaŋ lɛ
v: Mɛi ni s’mɔɔ Bo kɛ omaŋ lɛ,
Mɛi ni tsuɔ enii daa gbi,
Mɛi ni lomɔɔ, mɛi ni jɔɔ.
Gbi fɛɛ gbi, kojomɔ gbi ni,
Kɛmiitsɛ mɛi ni kwaa Lɛ lɛ,
Namɔ yɛ ef’lo yɛ nikpamɔ mli,
Be mli ni ŋmaa etsu kɛbole lɛ?
Ni Nuntsɔ lɛ kɛɔ tsulɔ fɛɛ tsulɔ,
ŋɔɔ tsɛmɔ ni ŋwɛi bɔfoi tete naaa;
Nyɛyaa mra, naa bee lɛ miiho oya,
Ni h’lu shinyɔɔ mli miishɛɛ gbee aaagbɛɛ,

hymns.t: Biɛ kɛ Shɔŋŋ Fɛɛ ŋmɔji Eyi
v: Biɛ kɛ shɔŋŋ fɛɛ ŋmɔji eyi
Tsu amɛ leebi be mli mra,
Be ni hulu naagbee lɛ yɛ,
Oo, nyɛ mɛi ni Nuntsɔ lɛ tsuɔ
Nyɛyaa hiɛ, tsɛ je aaana nyɛ,
Waa kɛ saŋŋ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ boɔ tsɛɔ,
Ni kã shi kɛyaa ŋwɛi lɛ,
Aaafee nɔ ni ŋwɛi taoɔ kέ.
Yɛ shɔŋŋ duŋ ŋa kplanaa lɛ nɔ
He ni fέi ko yeŋ amɛ yɛ?
Yɛ shɔŋŋ gɔji grɔŋi anɔ hu,
Kunim Maŋtsɛ, Kristo, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ kunim tai lɛ yɛ ekomeŋ.
Nuntsɔ, awo onɔ yɛ sɛŋ’tso nɔ,
Yɛ oshiwoo naa, hã wɔba oŋɔɔ.
Yijiemɔ hã Mɔ ni asέŋ lɛ lɛ.
c: Wo sɛŋ’tso nɔ, Kristo suɔmɔ nyɛgbaa,
Kɛyashi jeŋ fɛɛ aaawo egbɛi lɛ.

v: Keenii fɛɛ ni ohã wɔ lɛ,
Be ni wɔjaa, hã wɔ ninaa
Ehã wɔtsu nii kɛ tsui fɛɛ

hymns.t: Oo Yesu Kristo, Bo, Mɔ ni Sa Lalai
v: Oo Yesu Kristo, Bo, mɔ ni sa lalai
Yɛ hei fɛɛ yɛ osuɔmɔ lɛ hewɔ;
Muu owo wɔsɔlemɔ kɛ jamɔ mli,
Jɔɔmɔ wɔ kɛ omumɔ lɛŋ miishɛɛ.
Wɔwaje mɛi ni gbeɔ shi ni hewaaa lɛ,
Kɛyekɛbua mɛi ni bɛ mɔ ko lɛ.
Muu omumɔ oshwie maji fɛɛ anɔ
Otao obua mɛi fɛɛ naa yɛ suɔmɔ mli,
Otsa mɛi ni ta otade lɛ he.
Oo Zion, ye oyai, obee lɛ miiho,
Kɛɛmɔ je lɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji la,
Akɛ Mɔ ni bɔ maji fɛɛ lɛ taooo
Akɛ mɔ kome po hiɛ akpãtã.
Gbaa ohã maji, gbɔmɛi kɛ lilɛii fɛɛ,
Akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, Bɔlɔ lɛ, suɔmɔ ni;
Bɔ ni egbo koni wɔna wala.
Hã obii ayajaje nyam sane lɛ;
Kɛ onii lɛ awo amɛgbɛ mra;
Nii ni oooŋmɛɛ, Yesu aaato najiaŋ.
Eeba ekoŋŋ; oo Zion, gbaa mɛi fɛɛ kwa
Kaahã mɔ ko ni egbo ehã lɛ lɛ
Oo nɛgbɛ nikpalɔi ni buaa ŋmaa naa
Kɛjɛɔ esha ŋmɔji amli lɛ yɔɔ?
Hejɔlɛ bɛ, ja ŋmaa lɛ eshɛ shĩa.
ŋmɔji lɛ etsu, eda ni elɛɛ,
Ni je lɛ miimɛ nikpamɔbe lɛ;
Nitsumɔ lɛ da, nikpalɔi lɛ faaa,
Pii aaalaje kɛ nikpamɔ lɛ mɛ.
Nyɛkuaa ŋmaa, nyɛbuaa ŋmaa kpakpa lɛ naa
Nyɛkɛ lɛ aaanya yɛ nikpamɔ we.
Nyɛjiea amɛ yɛ esha kɛ gbeleŋ,
Gbaa amɛ, Yesu, H’relɔ lɛ sane.
Mɔ ni aaahe aye lɛ, eeena faa.
Kɛɛmɔ laajelɔ lɛ, H’relɔ ko gbo.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni nuɔ sane nɛɛ lɛ
Tsɛ lɛ miimɛ, ba shia koo.
c: Yɛ maŋ, ŋshɔ hiɛ, kpã waa;
Nyɔŋmɔ ni fã, gbaa sane lɛ!

v: Wɔduɔ wui kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ yɛ leebi mli,
Wɔduɔ yɛ shwane kɛ jenamɔ mli fɛɛ;
Ni wɔmɛɔ dalɛ, tsuu kɛ nikpamɔ be;
Wɔkɛ nyamɔ aaakpa nii lɛ kɛba shĩa.
Wɔduɔ nii yɛ la hiɛ, yɛ duŋ lɛ mli tete,
Ni wɔsheee atatui loo fέi ko gbeyee;
Nikpamɔbe lɛ shɛɔ, nitsumɔ baa naagbee;
Wɔkɛ nyamɔ aaakpa nii lɛ kɛba shĩa.
Wɔkɛ yafonui yaa yaduɔ Nuntsɔ nii lɛ,

Gɔŋ kɛ enɔ wala tsoyibii lɛ
Jɛmɛ Maŋtsɛ lɛ he yɛ fɛo pam,
Lɛ ji la kɛ kane yɛ jɛŋ;
Ehe fɛo mli wɔɔna lɛ yɛ,
Wɔɔshɛ jɛŋ, wɔɔshɛ jɛŋ be fioo mli,

hymns.t: Suɔmɔ ni Gbooo ni Eyɛ Daa
v: Suɔmɔ ni gbooo ni eyɛ daa,
Minyɛŋ mi kɛ lɛ agb’la mli,
Ni ekɛɔ mi nɔ ni mafee,
Fɛo nii fɛɛ ni kpɛɔ lɛ

hymns.t: Bɔ Ni Wu Ji Kɛhã Eŋa
v: Bɔ ni wu ji kɛhã eŋa
Bɔ ni bulɔ ji kɛhã mɔɔ,
Bɔ ni nu fέɔ yɛ abɔɔ mli,
Ni kane kpɛɔ yɛ duŋ mli;
Bɔ ni jwetri yɔɔ frotro mli,
Bɔ ni kane kpɛɔ yɛ lantέŋ,
Ji tsɛ ataa yɛ shĩã mli;
Bɔ ni hulu tsoɔ yɛ ŋwɛi,
Bɔ ni agbami yɔɔ tso nɔ,
Ji bɔ yɛ jwɛi frɔfrɔ nɔ;

hymns.t: Feemɔ Dioo, Nuntsɔ lɛ Yɛ Osɛɛ
v: Feemɔ dioo, Nuntsɔ lɛ yɛ osɛɛ,
Yɛ jramɔ, piŋmɔ mli tete, na tsui;
Shi fɛɛ ohã Nyɔŋmɔ, eeeye ehã o,
Feemɔ dioo: ni oŋwɛi Naanyo lɛ
Kɛ bo aaatsɔ nɔnaaŋ kɛya nyam mli.
Ni lɛ eeekudɔ nii ni baa lɛ fɛɛ;
Naakpɛɛnii lɛ aaafee faŋŋ wɔsɛɛ ko.
Feemɔ dioo: Ahum lɛ le lolo
Gbee ni ye enɔ be ko yɛ biɛ lɛ.
Feemɔ dioo: be lɛ miiba oya,
Ni wɔkɛ Nuntsɔ aaahi naanɔ mli.
Aw’rɛhoo bɛ, suɔmɔ, miishɛɛ sɔŋŋ yɔɔ.
Feemɔ dioo: be ni yaafo bɛ dɔŋŋ,
Aaajɔɔ wɔ ni wɔfɛɛ wɔɔkpe ekoŋŋ.
Oo mɛɛ ŋwɛi nyam naasaa hu ji enɛ!
Emumɔ fɔ mi, ela h’re mi.
Nibii ni yɔɔ fɛo hu minaa nɛɛ.
Yɛ miɔHerelɔ mli ajɔɔ mi yɛ.
Miis’ra, miimɛ, ni miikwɛ ŋwɛi gbɛ,
c: Majie mih’relɔ yi daa kɛ daa;
Majie mih’relɔ yi daa kɛ daa.

v: Yɛ Yesu too mli: wɔ yɛshweshweeshwe.
Yɛ ŋwɛi shĩa lɛ mli lɛ,
Kɛ jeŋ aaate shi awo mi,
Kã shi, bo mɔ ni etɔ o
Baahã mɔ ni kumai yeɔ lɛ,
Kwɛmɔ mi, ni je aaatsɛre o,
Ni wala la nɛɛ mli minyiɛɔ
Yɛ mimli kɛ mitsui mli tɔɔ
Lala kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ fe fɛɛ miigbɛɛ,
Aŋɔ tee, ni hewalɛ ko nyɛŋ
Be ni mashɛ nɛkɛ hejɔlɛ maŋ
He ni mana hejɔlɛ Tsɛ lɛ;
Yɛ nakai ŋwɛi maŋ lɛ mli
Ni onyiɛ tɔlɛ, deŋme gbɛ nɔ;
Oo ŋɔɔ nɛkɛ hejɔlɛ krɔŋŋ nɛɛ.
c: Ni jɛ ŋwɛi Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ kɛmiiba,
Ba ni obahi mimli kɛya naanɔ,
Kɛ suɔmɔ kple ni bɛ naagbee.

v: Bɔ ni wɔɔnyɛ, bɔ ni sa,
Wala ŋɔɔ! nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni baa,
Wala ŋɔɔ, kɛ mɔ ko s’mɔɔ mi,
Suɔmɔ ji tɔmɔ kɛ faa kwraa,
Nyɔŋmɔ s’mɔ wɔ yɛ Kristo mli,
Suɔmɔ ni piŋ, he ye, kpa gbɛ,
Suɔmɔ ni ye gb’le nɔ kunim;
Mitsɛ yɛ shĩai kɛ shikpɔji fɛɛ,
Ehiɛ jeŋ ninamɔnii fɛɛ yɛ edɛŋ.
Mitsɛ diɛŋtsɛ Bi, mɛi fɛɛ akpɔlɔ,
Be ko, etsomlo yɛ jeŋ fɛ ’hiafoi fɛɛ.
Ni eeehã mi shĩa, kɛ eba ekoŋŋ lɛ.
Kulɛ akwa mi, mɔkpɔŋ yɛ je nɛɛŋ,
Mikɔ eshafeemɔ, ni mitsɔ gbɔ kwraa.
Shi aŋɔ mi bialɔ, aŋma migbɛi,
Ni ahã mi shĩa, atade, akekre.
Buu jio, agba jio, tsuiyeli ko bɛ,
Aama maŋtsɛ we ahã mi yɛ jɛmɛ.
Tsɛ mibɛ shĩa moŋ, kέlɛ mala daa;
“Ajie Nyɔŋmɔ yi, Maŋtsɛ lɛ bi ji mi.”
c: Miji Maŋtsɛ lɛ bi, lɛ ebi ji mi!
Yesu ji mikpɔlɔ, Maŋtsɛ lɛ bi ji mi!

v: Mɛɛ naanyobɔɔ nɛ, mɛɛ ŋwɛi miishɛɛ nɛ,
Mɛɛ jɔɔmɔ minaa, mɛɛ toiŋjɔlɛ hu,
Oo mɛɛ ŋɔɔmɔ yɔɔ gbɛfaa krɔŋŋ nɛɛ mli
Oo gbɛ lɛ nɔ kpɛɔ faŋŋ waa daa nɛɛ
Mɛni fãa mitsui, mɛɛ gbeyee misheɔ
Ni fe je nɛɛ mli nyamɔi fɛɛ
Jɔɔmɔi ni ehãa mi amrɔ nɛɛ
c: Yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ nyamɔ be nɛɛ mli,
Be ni Yesu hiɛ miikpɛ kɛ ŋmlɔ,

v: A coordenous ta paix, ta paix;
Padre danos, tu paz, tu paz;
Kɛ sɛŋmɔtso eji, ni woɔ minɔ,
Lala kɛkɛ ni mala ji, mabɛŋkɛ o,
Tsɛ tamɔ gbɛfalɔ, h’lu enyɔ shi,
Kɛ duŋ kpii ewo mi, tɛ matsɔle.
Yɛ lamɔ mli tete, mabɛŋkɛ o, miɔNyɔŋmɔ
Hã gbɛ lɛ atamɔ ŋwɛi atrakwei,
Bɔfoi lɛ tsɛɔ mi, mabɛŋkɛ o miɔNyɔŋmɔ,
B’lɛ mimaneh’lu mli mabɛŋkɛ o miɔNyɔŋmɔ
Kɛŋna nyamɔ fiji, makwɔ ŋwɛi gbɛ,
Mashi h’lu, nyɔŋts’re kɛ ŋulami fɛɛ.
Kέ milala fɛɛ ji, mabɛŋkɛ o miɔNyɔŋmɔ,

hymns.t: Hiɛmɔ Yesu Gbɛi lɛ Mli Kpέŋŋ
v: Hiɛmɔ Yesu gbɛi lɛ mli kpɛŋŋ,
Hiɛmɔ Yesu gbɛi lɛ mli daa,
Kɛ kai bɔle bo kɛkpe lɛ
Oo Yesu, gbɛi ni j’ra wa nɛɛ
Ba mɔbɔ’ sɛi lɛ hiɛ, kotomɔ lɛ,
Ba, tsui ni ekumɔ, gbaa osane lɛ;
Jeŋ naagba ko bɛ ni ŋwɛi nyɛɛɛ atsa.
Miishɛɛ hã yoy’rolɔ, la hã gbɛdulɔ,
Biɛ miishɛjelɔ lɛ kɛ suɔmɔ kɛɔ,
“Jeŋ naagba ko bɛ ni ŋwɛi nyɛɛɛ atsa.”
Naa Wala Aboloo, naa nui ni miiho
Kɛjɛ Nyɔmɔ sɛi hiɛ, krɔŋŋ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi;
Ba suɔmɔ okp’lɔ he, ba, ole akɛ
Jeŋ naagba ko bɛ ni ŋwɛi nyɛɛɛ atsa.
Ni tsɛɔ mi kɛjɛɔ je lɛŋ
Mɔ ni jɔɔ susuma ni mɛɔ.
Ni kɛjɛ Pisga gɔŋ lɛ nɔ
Kɛ gbɔmɔtso hee ni gbooo lɛ;
Tamɔ mɛi ni nu ni he ye
Wiemɔ yɛ ahum kɛ la lɛŋ,
Tamɔ mɛi ni nu ni he ye
Wiemɔ yɛ ahum kɛ la lɛŋ,
Mi pɛ minyɛŋ jatsui nɛɛ mat’re.
Yɛ mihaomɔi lɛŋ, eeeye ebua mi,
Eji Naanyo ni naa mɔ mɔbɔ;
Kwɛ bɔ ni jeŋ akɔnɔ fɔŋ
Ni mibaye je lɛ nɔ kunim.
Ni eshwie ela krɔŋŋ lɛ shi
Be ni bɔ enyɔ fɔfɔi anɔ;
Ni minu gbeŋ ko gbɛɛ yɛ mitoiŋ;
Ni lala gbeŋ ni ekɛ hã mi lɛ
Yaa nɔ gbɛɔ yɛ mitsui mli.
Mikɛ lɛ baahi trom lɛ mli,
Tsɛ je miina ni duŋ miiwo mi;
Shi ekɛ ŋaawoo kɛɔ mi ni miya;
Egbeŋ lɛ yaa nɔ tsɛɔ mi.
c: Ni ekɛ mi nyiɛ, ni ekɛ mi wie
Ni ekɛɛ, enɔ ji mi kwraa,
Ni miishɛɛ ni wɔna yɛ jɛmɛ lɛ,

v: Suɔmɔ ni hiɛ kã ni ekwaaa,
Nyɔŋmɔ to etsui shi hã mi
Loo nɔ ni wa fe lɛ,
Tsɔɔmɔ mi yɛ bee fɛɛ mli,
Tsɔɔmɔ mi yɛ daa gbi mli,
Tsɔɔmɔ mi be ni bɛ lɛ,
Tamɔ Tsɛ lɛ kɛ Bi lɛ;
Tamɔ yoo lɛ yɛ nubu lɛ he, mitao
Ni minu ni mih’relɔ lɛ wie:
“Yɛɛ nu yɛ minubu ni gbii lɛ mli.”
Mɛi akpei abɔ yɛ je nɛɛŋ ni miishwe,
Jeŋ nibii ni hãa mɔ miishɛɛ;
Shi fɛɛ shɛɛɛ naakpɛɛ jwetri ni mi –
Na yɛ Yesu miɔNuntsɔ lɛ mli.
Hewɔ lɛ, mibii, kɛ nii ni jeŋ hã nyɛ
Hã hɔji ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ;
MiɔNuntsɔ j’rɔ lɛ aaaba h’re o
c: Wo mikpl’u lɛ obɔ, oo Nuntsɔ,
ŋwɛi aboloo, hã mi ni maye matɔ,
Mikp’lu lɛ, eyi, hã mafee emuu.

v: Kɛha naagbee ta yɛ wɔwala nɛɛŋ.
He ni wɔnaa shidaamɔ yɛ dromɔŋ;
Wala loo gbele kɛ amɛmli tai fɛɛ
Nyɛŋ atsi wɔnaa, yɛ ohiɛnaa mli.
Bee pii mli wɔtao wɔna kɛmiishɛɛ;
Esha je nɛɛ mli jɔɔmɔi lɛ miikwa po,
Kɛ wɔna o, wɔnaa miishɛɛ, hewalɛ;
Wɔbaana Yesu, egbo, te shi, damɔŋ,
He ko yɛ hã hejɔɔmɔ kpoo,
He ni esha nyɛɛɛ ahao mɔ,
He ko yɛ, wɔkɛ nii fɛɛ hãa,
Naanɔ Suɔmɔ, wɔkɛ nɔ kpakpa ko hãaa o,
Wɔkɛ nɔ kpakpa ko ehiɛɛɛ wɔdɛŋ,
Wɔbɛ lala ko ni aaasa Bo ohiɛ,
Loo wiemɔ krɔŋŋ, loo susumɔ ni sa.
Kɛ bɔfo w’lu ni mɛɔ wɔ yɛ jɛŋ lɛ.
Fe fɛɛ lɛ, Nuntsɔ, hii wɔmli,
Omasɛi nɔŋŋ miyɔɔ, be ni je tsɛre,
Be ni looflɔ teɔ shi ni duŋ yaa;
Etse fe leebi, eyɛ fɛo fe shwane,
Mi kɛ Bo pɛ yɔɔ yɛ naakpɛɛ hɔŋ lɛ mli,
Yɛ adebɔɔ leebi fɛɛfɛo lɛ mli;
Mi kɛ Bo pɛ yɔɔ woo kɛ yijiemɔ mli,
Yɛ leebi bɔ ni yɔɔ kpoo kɛ fɛo mli.
Omasɛi nɔŋŋ mi yɔɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni daa
Leebi teɔ shi kɛ fɛo kɛ kpɛmɔ;
Nakai susumɔ jurɔ nɛɛ teɔ shi,
Ekɛ daa gbi bɛŋkɛɔ Bo kɛ ŋwɛi.
Ni naagbee lɛ nakai leebi lɛ aaakpɛ,
Sus’ma lɛ aaate shi, duŋ aaalaaje;
Oo nakai be ni aaakpɛ fe shwane lɛ,
Nii fɛɛ hã lɛ yɛ sɔl’mɔŋ!
Naagba hu yɛ he ko lo?
Kɛ bɔ ni hãa wɔ j’rɔ miinyɔ
Kɛmi ahi shi kɛ je na,
Jɔɔmɔ mi, kɛ mihiɛ tsέ lɛ,
Ni manyiɛ Bo ogbɛ lɛ nɔ;
Mapue yɛ oŋwɛi maŋ lɛ mli.

hymns.t: He ko Yɛ ni Yɔɔ Kpoo
v: He ko yɛ ni yɔɔ kpoo,
He ni tso hãa hɔŋ sɛɛ;
Jɛŋ, mi kɛ Lɛ yɛ be kpoo mli
Mate shi mayakpee gbi hee nɛɛ
Yɛ jeŋ gbɛfaa ni wa nɛɛ mli,
Ni mahi shi hã Yesu daa.
Kɛwa mi yɛ be fɛɛ be mli,
Ni manyiɛ gbɛ leleoo lɛ nɔ
Yɛ miɔTsɛ nyam dromɔ lɛ naa.

hymns.t: Mɔɔ ko ni Wa, WɔɔNyɔŋmɔ ni
v: Mɔɔ ko ni wa, wɔɔNyɔŋmɔ ni,
Shikpɔŋ lɛ mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ lɛ.
Mikɛ Yesu gboɔ, gb’le ni sa mi,
Mikɛ Yesu hiɔ shi, ŋwɛi wala hee,
Be fɛɛ be, Nuntsɔ, onɔ ji mi kwraa.
Haomɔ ko bɛ ni ebɛ mimasɛi,
Jatsu ko hu bɛ ni lɛ etereee,
Awerɛhoo ko bɛ ni enuuu he,
Be fɛɛ be miyɛ ekwɛmɔ shishi.
Yaafonu, nɔnaa ko bɛ ni enaaa,
Osh’ra ko bɛ, shi eyɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ,
Be fɛɛ be, ejwɛŋɔ ebii ahe.
Gbɔjɔmɔ ko bɛ ni lɛ enuuu he,
Hela ko bɛ ni lɛ enyɛɛɛ etsa,
Be fɛɛ be, haomɔ loo miishɛɛ be mli,
Yesu, miɔHerelɔ lɛ kɛ mi yɛ.
c: Be fɛɛ be eto mi yɛ esuɔmɔŋ,
Be fɛɛ be miyɛ wala ni jɛ ŋwɛi;
Be fɛɛ be, Nuntsɔ, onɔ ji mi kwraa.

v: He fɛɛ he, maya shweshweeshwe kɛ Yesu,
He fɛ he ekp’laa mi kɛyaa yɛ je nɛɛŋ,
He fɛɛ he ni ebɛ mli lɛ miishɛɛ bɛ,
He fɛɛ he kɛ Yesu lɛ, miisheee gbeyee.
He fɛɛ he kɛ Yesu lɛ, jeee mi kome;
Nanemɛi aaakwa mi, Lɛ lɛ minɔ ni;
Tsɛ eeekpla mi kɛtsɔ duŋ gbɛi lɛ anɔ,
He fɛɛ he kɛ Yesu lɛ, yijiemɔ yɛ.
He fɛɛ he kɛ Yesu lɛ manyɛ mawɔ,
Be ni duŋ atatu kpii ebɔle mi,
Mile akɛ mate shi, mikpaaa shi dɔŋŋ,
He fɛɛ he kɛ Yesu lɛ, shĩa ni ŋɔɔ ni.
c: He fɛɛ he! he fɛɛ he!
He fɛɛ he kɛ Yesu lɛ

v: Mɛɛ shishifã ni wa nɛ, nyɛɔNuntsɔ lɛ
Mɛni eeefee fe nɔ ni ekɛɛ nyɛ lɛ,
Nyɛ mɛi ni Yesu ŋɔɔ nyɛbɔ abo yɛ?
Mawaje bo, ni mahã odamɔ shi,
“Kɛ oofo nui ni mitsɛɔ ni ofo lɛ,
Awerɛhoo fai lɛ yiŋ kɛteke nɔ,
Mikɛ bo aaahi shi, majɔɔ onaagbai,
Ni mibatsuu opiŋmɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahe.”
“Kɛ la naagbai ba ogbɛ nɔ tete lɛ,
Midromɔ ni fa lɛ aaafee bo onɔ,
La lɛ epilaŋ bo, mi mifee, ni no
Kɛ gbohiiaje fɛɛ hoso lɛ tete,
Mikwaŋ lɛ, dabi, mikwaŋ lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.”
No lɛ eeehi omasɛi bee fɛɛ,
Mɛi ni hiɛ kã esuɔmɔ nɔ
Mɛɛ sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ yaafo flo mli,
Kɛ oyɛ ekwɛmɔ kɛ too mli,
Mɔ ni t’re sɛŋmɔtso hã o lɛ
Kɛ o aaatso mli bɔ ni sa pɛ.
ŋmɛɛ otsui shi ohã ebe lɛ,
Enii ni eŋɔ hã o lɛ, ŋɔɔ nɔ,
Nii ni ekɛ suɔmɔ hã ni;
Ni kaaje lɛ ŋwane ko hu,
Lɛ mɔ ni h’la o efee enɔ.
La, sɔlemɔ, ni too egbɛi lɛ,
ŋɔɔ ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ, tsɛ osaaa,
Mɔ ni efi shi yɛ Emli.
Mileee bɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ nyiɛɔ
Ni kɛ mikɛ lɛ nyiɛ jɔɔ nɛɛŋ
Yɛ mihiamɔ mli, Yesu yɛ daa,
Ekwaaa kɔkɔɔkɔ, bee muu lɛ fɛɛ;
Ehãa jatsui tsɔɔ nii hee ni ŋɔɔ,
Yɛ mihiamɔ mli, Yesu he wa,
Ehãa mi hetoo kɛ mitsɛ lɛ,
Hei fɛɛ ni eeekp’la mi lɛ,
Bo toi ni oŋɔ osafo sɔlemɔ,
Hã jeŋ hejɔlɛ, ni kɛ wɔgbe ta naa,
Nuntsɔ ji mila; mɛɛ gbeyee mashe?
Shwane kɛ gbɛkɛ, ebɛŋkɛ mi daa,
Yɛ haomɔŋ, esha mli, ehereɔ mi;
Mumɔ lɛ hãa mi yiŋtsɔmɔ jurɔ nɛɛ.
Nuntsɔ ji mila, kɛ duŋ wo tete,
He ni Yesu yeɔ lumɔ yɛ nyam mli,
Ani mɛni aaahã mahi duŋ lɛ mli?
Ni hemɔkɛyeli naa ehiɛɔ mi yɛ.
Nuntsɔ ji mila kɛ minɔ fɛɛ nɔ;
Ni yɛ lɛ ehiɛ lɛ duŋ ko kwraa bɛ;
Lɛ ji miɔKpɔlɔ, Herelɔ kɛ Maŋtsɛ;
c: Nuntsɔ ji mila, miishɛɛ, kɛ lala,
Shwane kɛ gbɛkɛ, etsɔɔ mi gbɛ daa;
Nuntsɔ ji mila, miishɛɛ, kɛ lala,
Shwane kɛ gbɛkɛ, etsɔɔ mi gbɛ daa.

v: Be fɛɛ, miɔH’relɔ lɛ kp’laa mi,
Ni mile yɛ minii fɛɛ mli,
Ni mile yɛ minii fɛɛ mli,
Be fɛɛ, miɔH’relɔ lɛ kp’laa mli,
Yɛ Tɛsaa ni ma mihiɛ mli
Yɛ Tɛsaa ni ma mihiɛ mli
Be fɛɛ, miɔH’relɔ lɛ kp’laa mi,
Yɛ miɔTsɛ ŋwɛi shĩa lɛ mli;
Yesu kp’la mi gbɛ lɛ fɛɛ.
Yesu kp’la mi gbɛ lɛ fɛɛ.
Ajie eyi yɛ naanɔ bee fɛɛ amli;
Anumnyam yɛ ŋwɛi floflo mikɛ aala,
Midamɔ shiwoi ni fiteŋ lɛ anɔ,
Kɛ gbeyee kɛ ŋwanejee kɔɔyɔi aaatswa,
Yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ naa, maye kunim,
Mikpɛtɛ lɛ kɛŋya naanɔ yɛ suɔmɔŋ,
Mikɛ Mumɔ lɛ klante yeɔ kunim daa;
Naakpɛɛ H’relɔ ji Yesu miɔNuntsɔ lɛ,
Naakpɛɛ H’relɔ ji lɛ hã mi.
Ekɛ misusuma toɔ tɛkplo lɛ mli,
He ni mina miishɛɛ fai yɛ.
Naakpɛɛ H’relɔ ji Yesu miɔNuntsɔ lɛ,
Emɔɔ mimli, ni migbeŋ shi kɔkɔɔkɔ,
Ekɛ jɔɔmɔi pii woɔ mibeɔfɛɛɔbe mli
Ni eyiɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nii fɛɛ,
Mikɛ miishɛɛ laa, anumnyam hã Nyɔŋmɔ,
Be ni ekpɛmɔ aaaha mi, mate shi
c: Ekɛ misusuma toɔ tɛkplo lɛ mli,
Shikpɔŋ gbiŋ kɛ kumai bɛ jɛŋ,
Ekɛ miwala toɔ esuɔmɔ lɛ mli,

hymns.t: Mihiɛ Kãaa nɔ ko nɔ ko nɔ
v: Mihiɛ kãaa nɔ ko nɔ ko nɔ,

hymns.t: Nuntsɔ lɛ Yɛ Ehe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ
v: Nuntsɔ lɛ yɛ ehe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ,
Nuntsɔ lɛ yɛ ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ,
Shikpɔŋ lɛ afee dioo, afee dioo
Lɛɛlɛŋ, lɛɛlɛŋ, Nuntsɔ lɛ ba biɛ,
Gbi fɛɛ gbi, Nuntsɔ, mibiɔ nibii etɛ:

hymns.t: Nuntsɔ Kpa Wɔ kɛ Bo Ojɔɔmɔ
v: Nuntsɔ, kpa wɔ kɛ Bo ojɔɔmɔ;
Kp’lamɔ mi, Nuntsɔ, yɛ ojalɛ naa;
Shi Bo, oo Nuntsɔ, okoome pɛ

hymns.t: Nyɔŋmɔ Yɛ Ehe Krɔŋkrɔŋ Lɛ Mli
v: Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli,
Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli
Shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ afee diŋŋ yɛ ehiɛ,
Afee diŋŋ, afee diŋŋ yɛ ehiɛ.
Tsɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe, bo wɔ toi,
Jɔɔmɔ mɛi ni mɛɔ yɛ ohiɛ nɛɛ.
Lɛ edɛŋ jɔɔmɔi fɛɛ kwa jɛɔ,
Tsɛ, Bi kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Lɛ edɛŋ jɔɔmɔ fɛɛ kwa jɛɔ,
Tsɛ, Bi kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
